questions.question_text: Which of these is a task included in the TOEFL iBT Writing section?
options: Listening to a lecture and summarizing it.
Repeating words heard on a recording.
Reading a passage and answering multiple-choice questions.
questions.explanation: The test structure table explicitly identifies 'Write for an Academic Discussion' as a task in the Writing section.

questions.question_text: What is true regarding the use of writing assistance software during the TOEFL iBT test?
options: It is encouraged to improve score accuracy.
It is permitted only in the home edition.
It is allowed if the test taker has a disability.
questions.explanation: The FAQs explicitly state that writing assistance software is not permitted during the TOEFL iBT test.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a task included in the Writing section?
questions.explanation: Writing an email is explicitly listed as a task type for the TOEFL iBT Writing section.

questions.question_text: What does the 'Write for an Academic Discussion' task involve?
options: Writing your perspective on a class discussion topic
questions.explanation: This task assesses your ability to engage in academic discourse and express ideas clearly.

questions.question_text: What is the rule regarding 'writing assistance software' during the test?
options: It is only allowed for the Speaking section
questions.explanation: The use of writing assistance software is strictly prohibited during the test to ensure fair assessment of language skills.

questions.question_text: How many items are typically in the Writing section?
questions.explanation: According to the test overview, there are 12 items listed for the Writing section.

questions.question_text: What should a test taker focus on in the Writing section?
options: The length of the response above all else
Adding as many fancy fonts as possible
questions.explanation: The test measures real academic skills, so clear and accurate communication is the primary goal.

questions.question_text: Which task is included in the TOEFL iBT Writing section?
questions.explanation: The Writing section includes tasks such as building sentences, writing emails, and writing for academic discussion.

questions.question_text: What is the policy on 'writing assistance software' like grammar checkers during the test?
options: It is permitted if you are using a home laptop
It is not permitted at any time
It is only allowed for the email task
It is provided by the test center
questions.explanation: The test measures your own writing abilities, so external assistance tools are prohibited.
